answer: Splitting pays only because each key is credited alone, so credit a key for the marginal gain its answer adds over the best answer already linked to it by referral, then pay that tree a concave share of its total: ten keys repeating one argument earn roughly what one earns. The farmer pays twice: extra keys stop multiplying revenue, and each must still fund its own reasoning on a distinct claim. A falcon gains nothing by circling one thermal twice, and a spiral of nested accounts collapses to its strongest node. Many lotus accounts holding one text are worth a single flower.
